summary: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd (IBG) filed Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the completion of an independent reserve report and multi-phase development plan by its proposed merger partner, BlockFuel Energy, for Central Oklahoma oil and gas assets. The release details operational progress—19 wells returned to production—and future plans including recompletions and drilling up to 28 new vertical wells over 2026-2028. No transaction terms, merger agreement details, or definitive deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine operational update, not a special-situation event. There is no binding M&A agreement, and the filing lacks deal terms, pricing, or board recommendation.
